name: create-avatar
description: Use when a new bot needs a picture: make a Bot Builder avatar through its MCP server with curl, save the 2048 PNG and share link in ROOT/avatars, have the bot set it.
purpose: give a bot a front-facing Bot Builder avatar unlike the others in ROOT/avatars
input: optional picks: option IDs from get_bot_options
steps: from each ROOT/avatars/*.url query take character (missing = bot) and accessory (missing = none)
no picks: call randomize_bot with {}; picks: call create_bot with {"selections": {<picks>, "frame": "front-center"}}
parse result.content[0].text as JSON; take its selections

in selections: set frame to front-center; delete every key named in unavailableFields (export_bot rejects them); delete size (character size collides with PNG size 2048 in downloadUrl: 'Use size 1024 or 2048.')
same character or same accessory as an existing bot: back to step 2, up to 3 rerolls
downloadUrl still has a size= other than size=2048: strip that parameter
download downloadUrl to ROOT/avatars/<bot>.png; check it is a 2048 x 2048 PNG
write export_bot's url (the share link) to ROOT/avatars/<bot>.url, one line
look at the PNG; garbled, blank or cut off: back to step 2 (counts as a reroll)
message the new bot with the PNG attached: set it as your avatar with UpdateAvatar, then confirm; a bot can only set its own picture
decide: isError true: read its text, fix the named field, retry once; still failing: fallback
picks given and they match an existing bot: keep picks; tell owner which bot it resembles
3 rerolls still match: keep the last; tell owner which bot it resembles
ROOT/avatars/<bot>.png exists: ask owner before overwriting

server down or still failing: fallback only, https://botbuilder.mipmap.ai/ in the desktop browser: its WebMCP tools if exposed, else the UI (Randomize, Frame tab Centered, 2x / Download PNG 2048 x 2048, copy share link); save to the same two files
run: curl -sS -X POST https://botbuilder.mipmap.ai/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"<tool>","arguments":<arguments>}}'
tools: get_bot_options, create_bot, edit_bot, randomize_bot, get_bot_share_link, export_bot; schemas: same curl with {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}
never: drop the Accept header from the curl; without it the server answers Not Acceptable
pass randomize_bot's selections to export_bot unchanged
use the browser path while the MCP server works
